newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Shaw Wallace director arrested.
newsitem.headline: India's Shaw Wallace director arrested.

text.p: Indian authorities said on Tuesday they had arrested a director of liquor maker Shaw Wallace and Co Ltd in connection with an investigation into possible violations of foreign exchange laws.
Enforcement Directorate authorities arrested executive director P.L. Narasimhan late on Monday, officials in the government agency told Reuters.
"This is the first arrest made by the Enforcement Directorate in the alleged 900 million rupee foreign exchange rules violation by Shaw Wallace and Company," a directorate official said.
Narasimhan denied a claim by the Enforcement Directorate that he had confessed to any wrongdoing.

"Whatever I have done is under the instructions of my chairman," he told reporters after he was arrested. "Some people to save themselves have passed certain comments about me and that has brought me to this state."
The Enforcement Directorate has arrested 12 serving or retired executives of tobacco and hotels group ITC Ltd in a separate investigation into possible forex violations.
Both Shaw Wallace and ITC have their headquarters in Calcutta.
